news.title: Musk says he'll give one of his SpaceX shares to every U.S. child next year
news.summary: Musk posted on X Monday that he will give each American child one of his SpaceX shares next year, calling it 'the first of many', without saying how it would work. With about 72 million U.S. children, CNBC put the giveaway at roughly $10.5B at Friday's $146.03 close; Musk owned about 4.8 billion shares per an August filing.

news.title: SpaceX and Tesla earnings this week will test Musk's AI spending as merger talk grows
news.summary: SpaceX reports Q3 after the close Tuesday, its second report as a public company; LSEG consensus is about $12.74B revenue and EPS of $0.14, versus Q2's $7.8B revenue, $541M net loss and $15.8B of AI capex. Barclays suggested last week a SpaceX–Tesla deal could come before Tesla's Dec. 3 annual meeting, with SpaceX the likelier acquirer; neither company has committed to one.

news.title: SpaceX will post Q3 2026 results after the close on Tuesday, Oct. 20
news.summary: SpaceX said it will release third-quarter financial and operational results after market close on Oct. 20 and host a live audio-only webcast at 3:30 p.m. CT / 4:30 p.m. ET, also streamed on X @SpaceX; investors can submit questions in advance.

news.title: Trump denies the White House ordered Starlink/Starshield restrictions in Ukraine; SpaceX reports Tuesday
news.summary: Trump said 'it wasn't me, and I don't think it was Elon' after Musk said Starshield is owned and controlled by the U.S. government; Reuters had cited two U.S. officials saying the call came from the White House. The curbs cut connectivity for drones and vehicles above 160 km/h. CNBC noted SpaceX shares are down about 11% this week, with quarterly results scheduled for Tuesday. SPCX closed down 1.7% at $146.03.

news.title: Roadster demo with SpaceX thrusters revives Tesla–SpaceX merger talk; prediction-market odds near 56%
news.summary: The Roadster built with SpaceX thrusters 'helped respark' merger rumors, and prediction-market odds of a deal nearly doubled overnight to 56%, the Fool said. Both stocks fell with the tech selloff: SPCX −1.74%, TSLA −2.13%.

news.title: Tesla's new Roadster, built with SpaceX, flies on rocket-style thrusters; SPCX rises overnight
news.summary: At a SpaceX test site in McGregor, Texas, Tesla showed a Roadster co-developed with SpaceX that turned in the air and landed on built-in thrusters; Gene Munster called it an 'engineering flex' showing Musk 'can't wait' to bring Tesla and SpaceX together. SPCX closed down 2.3% at $148.62 on Thursday, its third straight loss, before trading higher overnight after the event.

news.title: Musk says Trump is 'ultimately' responsible for any curbs on Ukraine's Starshield systems
news.summary: After Ukraine accused SpaceX of imposing speed limits on Starlink/Starshield terminals in motion, disrupting drone operations, Musk said Starshield is owned and controlled by the U.S. government; some restrictions appeared to be partially lifted on Thursday.

news.title: SpaceX slips 2.8% as the hot-CPI selloff overshadows the CRS-35 NASA resupply launch
news.summary: SPCX fell for a second day, closing at $152.16, as a hotter-than-expected September inflation report pushed yields up and hit long-duration tech and AI names. Tuesday's successful CRS-35 cargo launch for NASA gave the stock no lift after its sharp early-October rally.

news.title: Morgan Stanley reiterates Overweight and $300 target, pointing to SpaceX's distributed inference cloud
news.summary: Analyst Adam Jonas said SpaceX's Distributed Inference Cloud is the part of the story with the most growth potential and is largely ignored by investors; the firm kept its Overweight rating and $300 price target.

news.title: SPCX drops as the FAA opens an environmental review of up to 456 Starship launches a year
news.summary: The FAA will prepare an environmental impact statement on SpaceX's plan to expand Starbase from today's cap of 25 launches to as many as 456 launches and 912 landings a year, in two phases (up to 100 launches first). Public comments are due Nov. 30; nothing is approved yet. SPCX closed down 4.2% at $156.54.

news.title: SpaceX agrees to testify Friday in New York City's AI safety probe
news.summary: SpaceX will appear before the NYC Council's technology committee on Friday after skipping an earlier hearing; the council had subpoenaed Musk and the company's AI unit in late September. Selling hit space stocks broadly, with the UFO space ETF down about 3% and Intuitive Machines down about 6% intraday.

news.title: CRS-35 Dragon lifts off with 6,300 lb of cargo and the station's final roll-out solar arrays
news.summary: Falcon 9 launched SpaceX's 35th NASA resupply mission from Cape Canaveral at 6:33 a.m. EDT Tuesday, carrying more than 6,300 pounds of supplies, experiments and the last pair of ISS Roll-Out Solar Arrays. Dragon is set to dock autonomously at 11 a.m. EDT Thursday, Oct. 15.
